title: Seller Calc Hub - Supporting SEO Guides Strategy
editorial_policy: Content strategy first: strictly informational guides answering real seller questions from keyword-plan-ranked.xlsx. Every guide contains verified facts from fee data, links to its primary calculator with descriptive anchor text, and targets an informational query distinct from all calculator pages.

guides.title: How eBay Calculates Fees: 2026 Seller Fee Math Explained
guides.metaDescription: Learn how eBay calculates seller fees across final value percentages, fixed per-order charges, and category tiers. Master the math to keep more profit today.
guides.h1: How eBay Calculates Seller Fees: The Complete Math Breakdown
verified_fee_facts: Standard Final Value Fee is 13.25% up to $7,500 and 2.35% thereafter for most categories.
Store subscribers receive a reduced 12.35% rate.
Fixed per-order fee is $0.30 for orders $10.00 or under, and $0.40 for orders over $10.00.
Payment processing is bundled into the Final Value Fee with no separate gateway surcharge.

guides.title: Does eBay Charge Fees on Shipping? The Truth & How to Save
guides.metaDescription: Does eBay charge fees on shipping? Yes. Discover why eBay applies fees to postage, how much you lose, and 3 proven strategies to protect your profit margin.
guides.h1: Does eBay Charge Fees on Shipping? Why & How to Protect Margins
guides.primary_keyword: does ebay charge fees on shipping
verified_fee_facts: eBay assesses the full 13.25% (or 12.35% Store) Final Value Fee on buyer-paid shipping.
On a $10 shipping charge, eBay deducts $1.33 in fees, leaving $8.67 for postage.
Commercial base postage discounts on eBay Labels offer up to 28% off retail USPS rates.

guides.title: Whatnot Fees Explained: Live Auction Commission & Payouts
guides.metaDescription: Understand Whatnot seller fees: 8% commission, 2.9% + $0.30 processing, and automated shipping. Calculate your exact livestream profit before going live today.
guides.h1: Whatnot Seller Fees Explained: Live Auction Commission & Net Take-Home
verified_fee_facts: Commission is a flat 8.0% assessed only on the hammer sale price.
Payment processing is 2.9% + $0.30 on the full transaction amount.
Whatnot does NOT charge its 8.0% commission on buyer-paid shipping labels.

guides.title: Etsy Offsite Ads Explained: 12% vs 15% Fees & Opt-Out Rules
guides.metaDescription: Complete guide to Etsy Offsite Ads: mandatory 12% vs optional 15% fees, the $10,000 threshold, 30-day attribution, and how to price your items profitably.
guides.h1: Etsy Offsite Ads Explained: How Attribution & Surcharges Work
verified_fee_facts: 12% mandatory fee for shops with trailing 12-month revenue of $10,000+ USD.
15% optional fee for shops with under $10,000 revenue (can opt out).
Fees are capped at a maximum of $100 per attributed order.
Attribution window lasts 30 days from initial buyer ad click.

guides.title: TikTok Shop Referral Fees Explained: 2026 Commission Rates
guides.metaDescription: Everything you need to know about TikTok Shop seller fees: 6.0% referral commission, affiliate creator cuts, and net social commerce payout schedules.
guides.h1: TikTok Shop Referral Fees Explained: Real Seller Costs & Margins
verified_fee_facts: Standard referral fee is 6.0% per order across most product categories.
Referral percentage is assessed on customer total payment including shipping.
Payment processing is bundled into the referral fee.

guides.title: Depop Seller Fees Explained: 0% Selling Fee & Processing
guides.metaDescription: How do Depop seller fees work? Learn how the 0% selling fee policy works, what 3.3% + $0.45 processing costs, and how Depop compares to Poshmark and eBay.
guides.h1: Depop Seller Fees Explained: The 0% Selling Commission Guide
verified_fee_facts: Depop eliminated its 10% selling fee for US sellers in July 2024.
Sellers pay 0% selling fee, retaining 100% of the item price minus processing.
Payment processing is 3.3% + $0.45 per transaction in the US.

guides.title: eBay UK Fees Explained: 0% Private vs Business Seller Rates
guides.metaDescription: Understand eBay UK fees: 0% private seller fees, 12.8% + 30p business rates, 20% VAT rules, and regulatory operating charges for UK resellers.
guides.h1: eBay UK Seller Fees Explained: Private vs Business Rate Comparison
guides.primary_keyword: ebay uk private vs business seller fees
verified_fee_facts: Private sellers in the UK pay 0% Final Value Fees and £0.00 insertion fees.
Business sellers pay standard 12.8% + £0.30 plus 20% VAT.
Regulatory operating fee of 0.42% applies to business transactions.

guides.title: How Etsy Calculates Fees: Complete Artisan Seller Fee Guide
guides.metaDescription: How does Etsy calculate selling fees? Learn the 6.5% transaction cut, $0.20 listing renewals, 3% + $0.25 payment processing, and hidden craft costs.
guides.h1: How Etsy Calculates Seller Fees: Listing, Transaction & Processing Math
verified_fee_facts: Listing fee is $0.20 for 4 months or until sold.
Transaction fee is 6.5% of total sale price including shipping.
Etsy Payments processing fee is 3.0% + $0.25 in the United States.

guides.title: How eBay Final Value Fees Work: Category Rates & Thresholds
guides.metaDescription: Demystify eBay Final Value Fees: category ladders from 6.7% to 15.3%, the $7,500 threshold, athletic sneaker waivers over $150, and Top Rated discounts.
guides.h1: How eBay Final Value Fees Work Across Different Product Categories
guides.primary_keyword: how do ebay final value fees work
verified_fee_facts: Guitars and musical instruments qualify for a lower 6.7% rate.
Athletic shoes sold at $150 or more pay 8.0% (waiving the fixed order fee).
Books, movies, and music pay 15.3% due to high catalog demand.

guides.title: Twitch Bits Payout Guide: What Creators Keep per 100 & 1,000
guides.metaDescription: Learn how Twitch Bits payouts work: exactly $0.01 per bit, how viewer markup works, when Twitch pays out, and how to reach the $50 minimum threshold.
guides.h1: Twitch Bits Streamer Payout Guide: Exact Cash Conversion & Rules
verified_fee_facts: Streamers receive exactly $0.01 USD per bit cheered in chat.
Viewers pay a 30% to 40% markup when purchasing bit bundles.
Twitch enforces a $50 minimum threshold for payouts on the 15th of each month.
